depiction.primary_object: outline of a house with pitched roof
depiction.composition: single object with corner modifier, front view

readings.meaning: household chores or home maintenance checklist
mortgage approval, closing, or property verification
home security or smart home status check

ambiguity: At very small sizes, the incomplete right wall and large checkmark can look like an upward-left arrow or a broken house outline.
task_intents: verify smart home security before trip
winterize the house before first freeze

example_tasks.task: Go through the radon and termite report with the inspector
Check all window locks and unplug toaster before heading to airport
Get the city occupancy permit signed off after basement remodel
Verify Airbnb host badge and address verification before summer season
Run through the winterizing checklist for the lake cabin
Confirm appraisal came back clean from the lender
Schedule the annual quatre-point inspection for homeowners insurance renewal
Test all smoke detectors, carbon monoxide alarms, and sump pump backup battery
Walk through the punch list with the general contractor before final payment
Make sure every smart lock and garage sensor shows green in HomeKit before leaving
Fill out the tenant condition report and photograph every scuff mark on the walls

example_tasks_es: Agendar la inspección técnica de la vivienda antes de firmar las arras
Revisión final del piso con el casero para recuperar la fianza
Repasar la lista de cierre de la casa antes de salir de vacaciones
example_tasks_ru: Приемка квартиры у застройщика со специалистом
Проверить перекрыта ли вода и выключен ли утюг перед выездом
Пройтись по чек-листу подготовки дачи к зиме

context_tasks.task: Bleed all the upstairs radiators before turning on the boiler
Clean out the maple leaves from the garage gutters
Replace the furnace air filter with a MERV 11 one
Caulk the gap around the guest bathroom tub

Check if the package arrived at the house
Finish the take-home exam for stats class
Order home-style fried chicken for dinner

reasoning: The icon clearly combines a house outline with a prominent checkmark, making it an intuitive representation of home inspections, property walkthroughs, move-in/move-out checklists, and seasonal house maintenance. It is distinct from a plain house icon by emphasizing verification, completion, or readiness of the property.
